$comment: Cross-language conformance fixture for log redaction (issue #1781). Read by BOTH the engine gtest suite (engine/tests/debug_redact_test.cpp, via VAYU_ENGINE_SOURCE_DIR) and the app's vitest suite (app/electron/log-redaction.conformance.test.ts). `secretFieldNames` is every name `is_secret_field_name` / `isSecretFieldName` must redact; `notSecretFieldNames` must pass through; `sensitiveHeaderNames` is the header list the app's snippet generator masks by name (app/src/lib/sensitive-headers.ts, issue #1806), each of which must also be a secret field name here, and the app's list must equal it; `sensitiveParamNames` is the query-parameter and Params-row name set `vayu_ext::blank_credential_param_rows` / `redact_url_credentials` blank (the shared secret field names less `code`, plus `EXTRA_SECRET_PARAM_NAMES`), which the MCP server's `SENSITIVE_PARAM_NAMES` (app/electron/mcp/withhold.ts, issue #1837) must equal, and `code` and `key` are deliberately not in it; `stripUrlSecrets` maps an input to what both `strip_url_secrets` and `stripUrlSecrets` must return.

stripUrlSecrets.name: request line keeps the protocol suffix
password containing an at sign, with a path
at sign in a query value is not userinfo
at sign in a path is not userinfo
scheme in a query value is not an authority
host with no credentials and no scheme
